title: SLP99 Program the Unit Size Code (E203 / three bars)
description: Configure the integrated control's unit size code after a control replacement, when the LED shows three horizontal bars followed by E203 at power-up.
safety_notes: Handle the integrated control with electrostatic-discharge precautions.
Do not touch the blower drive until its LEDs are off.

steps.title: Confirm the symptom
steps.instruction: At 24 V power-up, does the seven-segment LED show three horizontal bars followed by E203, or a letter A to F?
steps.expected_input: three bars and E203, or a letter

branches.condition: A letter A, b, C, d, E or F

steps.title: Read the model from the nameplate
steps.instruction: Read me the full model number from the unit nameplate, for example SLP99UH090XV60CK.

steps.title: Enter programming mode
steps.instruction: Set the room thermostat to OFF so the control is idle. Push and hold the button next to the LED until a solid P is displayed, then release. The P starts blinking.

steps.title: Select the code
steps.instruction: Push and hold the button. The control shows each unit size code for five seconds: A is 070-36B, b is 090-36C, C is 090-48C, d is 090-60C, E is 110-60C, F is 135-60D. Release when the code for your model is showing. It flashes for 10 seconds; during that time hold the button until the code stops blinking and disappears for two seconds. The control stores it and resets.
steps.expected_input: code stored, or the control returned to idle without storing

branches.condition: The code stopped blinking and the control reset
The 10 seconds expired or the control went idle without storing

steps.title: Verify the stored code
steps.instruction: Cycle the 24 V power to the control. At power-up the LED shows the stored code. Does the letter match the model on the nameplate?
steps.expected_input: letter matches, letter wrong, or three bars

branches.condition: The letter matches the nameplate model

steps.title: Programmed
steps.instruction: The unit size code is stored. If E202 appears afterwards, the blower motor horsepower does not match the code; re-check the nameplate model against the code table.
